register.labelZh: BREAK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: break up 可以表示學校或課程何時結束,並開始放聖誕假、復活節假、暑假或其他假期。；break up 可以描述實物碎成小塊,也可以描述一群人分成較小的組別。；你可以用 break up 談論戀愛關係的結束,也可以用 break with 談論合作或其他聯繫的結束。；break with tradition、practice 或 an old style 可以表示某人選擇不再依循一向的做法。
register.summaryEn: Break up allows you to say when a school or course finishes for Christmas, Easter, summer or another holiday. Break up can describe a physical object becoming pieces. It can also describe people dividing into smaller groups. You can use break up for a romantic relationship and break with for a wider partnership or connection. Break with tradition, practice or an old style shows that someone has chosen a different way of doing something.
contextsEn: Talk about different kinds of relationships ending
